$comment: MCP server registration. Runs bin/claude-workspaces-mcp.sh under /bin/sh, which resolves a node binary itself and execs the bundled mcp/index.js. It does NOT say `command: node`: node is often installed by nvm, whose PATH setup lives in ~/.zshrc, so `node` resolves in an interactive shell and nowhere else — sessions launched by launchd, a GUI app, or cron died with a bare ENOENT and no workspace tools. /bin/sh is the one interpreter always present. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is Claude Code's substitution for the install path, so nothing here is CWD-dependent. The bundle is regenerated by `bun run build:mcp` (which writes here and to packages/mcp/dist/mcp.js). Port is auto-discovered from ~/.claude/claude-workspaces/server.json. `scripts/migrate-rename.ts` moves that directory on the box at rollout; serve.ts writes only the new path, and the MCP child reads the new path first and the old one after it, because nothing orders the server restart against each session respawn.
